[[Abyssal]]s are the heavy melee fighters of the [[Shadow Army]]. They can massacre spell casters and warriors alike, especially with [[Deep Wound]] and [[knock down]]s. In addition to their knock down skills, Abyssals also knock down foes whenever they score [[critical hit]]s.

==Notes==
{{gw2w}}
*[[Blind]], [[weakness]] and [[interrupt]]ion are good against Abyssals. Traps are also useful against them.
*Spellcasters should avoid direct confrontation with Abyssals. They are capable of dishing out great damage, knockdowns and brutal [[interrupt]]s, taking out a caster in three hits, during which the victim will not have a chance to cast anything or run away. 
*[[Miniature Abyssal]] is based upon these creatures.
*There is an [[Abyssal Tonic]].
*Abyssals in the [[Domain of Anguish]] use [[Battle Rage]] even though it is their only adrenaline based skill.
*The icon used for monster skills in Prophecies resembles Abyssal's face.
* Deals blunt damage.
